newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks down slightly in thin London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks down slightly in thin London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London fell slightly on the back of overnight weakness in Wall Street, as Friday proved to be another quiet trading day, dealers said.
They said the settlement of December futures and stock options -- special quotations -- passed uneventfully.
At 1605 GMT the Nikkei 50 index was down 6.24 points at 1437.36, while Japan's Nikkei 225 closed down 159.81 points at 20,341.39 after earlier plunging nearly 550 points.
"It was pretty quiet today," said one dealer, adding: "There was a bit of weakness in the blue chip names like NEC and Sony."
"We've seen very little activity," said another trader, "The outlook is not very good at the moment, and I think it will stay like this into the new year."
